Source [S3] confirms that creating a voxel grid from a triangle mesh sets voxels to 1 if intersected by a triangle and 0 otherwise, defining the resolution via voxel size. Source [S6] describes a method that reads STL vertices, normalizes them to a resolution, and creates a numpy boolean array (voxel array) where voxels are occupied if intersected by the mesh.
